messages:
Aisha: Quick sync 1: infra scheduled a firmware fix but it won't land until the week after our ship. We need a soft-freeze exception plan for three features tied to the Apr milestone.
Connor: Which features?
Aisha: Tenant SSO GA, per-route analytics retention bump, and dynamic routing by cost tiers.
Marta: From PM: SSO GA is a strong buyer ask for 2 customers but not blockers for open signups. Analytics retention is mostly billing/observability for enterprise. Dynamic routing is nice-to-have for cost savings.
Diego: Eng: we can ship SSO as a concierge pilot behind a feature flag (hosted-only). That avoids Dedicated dependency. ETA for the concierge flow is 4 days.
Sam: Sales: concierge pilot is acceptable for one marquee customer but we need a public migration path to GA by v1. Also want SCIM and exportable audit logs in the pilot.
Connor: Ops note: concierge pilot needs a small Dedicated slot if we want strict isolation. Hosted with contract addendum is faster but more compliance work.
Aisha: Proposal: grant soft-freeze exception to implement SSO as "hosted-concierge" and gate GA; cut dynamic routing and defer analytics retention bump to v1.
Marta: OK but add rollback and telemetry checks. We should require a perf comparison for p95/p99 with and without concierge flow.
Diego: Will add telemetry checks and an auto-fallback toggle that disables bugsafe paths if errors spike >1.5% in 15m.
Sam: I'll confirm customer acceptance for concierge + legal addendum.
Connor: Action items:
- Diego: implement hosted concierge SSO flag + fallback toggle (3d)
- Marta: update milestone tracker, note exception and GA date (EOD)
- Sam: customer consent + legal wording (48h)
- Aisha: publish stakeholder note and update roadmap (EOD)
CI-Bot: branch protection: allow-exception/soft-freeze -> PR created by @Aisha (automated)
Aisha: Decision recorded: MVP ships Apr with cuts: dynamic routing deferred, analytics retention bumped to v1, SSO provided as hosted concierge pilot. Will capture perf evals and rollback criteria in the release notes.
